official_definition: Lore-wise, Lykeios is a nearly fanatical believer, and such faith is converted into power for the Grandwalkers, represented through multiple core in-game. Additionally, the return obtained for his intense faith is his other keyword, Dragonshot.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Super Boost] or [Super Boost: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Super Boost]", "give [Super Boost]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
